 Kukdo Chemical to Buy LG Chem's Daesan BPA Business for 78.4 Billion Won
 Acquisition covers 165,000-ton annual production capacity
 EunGyu Kim 
 Published 2026.10.26 22:30
 Reply 0

 LG Chem's Daesan plant. 
 Kukdo Chemical will acquire LG Chem's bisphenol A (BPA) business at its Daesan plant in South Chungcheong Province for 78.4 billion won.
 In a regulatory filing on Oct. 26, Kukdo Chemical said its subsidiary Kukdo International had decided to acquire LG Chem's BPA production and sales operations at the Daesan plant, along with all assets required to operate the business, for 78.4 billion won.
 The acquisition covers a BPA business with annual production capacity of 165,000 tons. BPA is a petrochemical feedstock used in epoxy resins and polycarbonates. Kukdo Chemical, the world's largest epoxy resin producer, has sourced BPA from LG Chem.
 The two companies began negotiations over the sale in April. Kukdo Chemical said the acquisition aims to "secure a stable supply of BPA, strengthen our ability to respond to market volatility, and maintain stable costs and profitability in our epoxy resin business."
 The transaction is expected to be completed in the first half of 2027, although the timetable may change depending on regulatory permits and approvals.
 LG Chem plans to reduce its commodity petrochemical operations through the sale of the Daesan BPA business and restructure its portfolio around higher-value-added products.
